title: Every kitchen should own one of these!
text: Every kitchen should own one of these!. This is a great little device. Makes cutting and serving pizza a breeze. Sometimes pizza cutting can be tricky but this tool does it all. I can cut the slices and then serve the slices in one step and I love it. This is also easy to clean up and I drop it into the dishwasher after use and it comes out looking like new. I could also see using this on cutting pies and cakes as well.This would make a cool and unique add-on bridal shower or new homeowner gift.

product_metadata.title: KUFUNG Pizza Cutter Shovel, Super Sharp Pizza Slicer with Non Slip Handle for Pizza, Pies, Waffles and Dough Cookies, Easy to Use and Clean (Black, B5)
